title: Recommended!
text:
Good experience overall. Small shop just one minute from the cathedral, with young, friendly, and polite staff. They gave us useful information and a map.

The negative reviews made us a bit worried, but the bikes did exactly what we needed for the price we paid. They were small, easy to ride, and the battery lasted all day.

They even let us keep the bikes for an extra hour at no additional cost. Thank you!!
